evidence: Sidebar lists 19 documents each tagged with a module badge (API, Authentication, Data Layer, UI Components, Core System); module filter buttons All/API/AUTH/DATA/UI/CORE let user browse by module.

Opening "REST API Design Guidelines" shows title, description, Content Sections (REST Principles, Endpoint Naming Conventions, Pagination & Filtering) and a Related Documents list (API Versioning Strategy, Error Handling Standards, HTTP Methods Guide, Rate Limiting).
Clicking "API Versioning Strategy" link inside an expanded section navigated the document panel to the API Versioning Strategy document (heading, sections, related docs updated accordingly).
Clicking "Endpoint Naming Conventions" header toggled it from expanded to collapsed; paragraph content and link (with cursor-pointer) disappeared, leaving only a disabled link chip.
Clicking the collapsed "Endpoint Naming Conventions" header again re-expanded it, showing the full paragraph and an interactive "HTTP Methods Guide" link (cursor-pointer restored).

Graph nodes are clickable (g.graph-node, cursor:pointer, onClick=handleNodeClick) and select/navigate to a document; a "Modules" legend maps module names to node colors (API, Authentication, Data Layer, UI Components, Core System).
Knowledge Graph tab renders an SVG (1280x643) containing all 19 document nodes with edges, plus Zoom In/Out/Reset View controls and a zoom% indicator, allowing the full graph to be viewed.
Top navigation contains exactly three tabs: Documents, Knowledge Graph, and Favorites (with live count badge).

Zoomed graph to 140%, switched to Documents tab and back to Knowledge Graph — zoom remained 140%. Collapsed a content section, switched to Favorites tab and back to Documents — section remained collapsed. localStorage "tech-docs-storage" persists sectionStates and graphState.

Favoriting 2 docs updated nav badge "Favorites 2" in real time; localStorage key "tech-docs-storage" stores favorites: ["accessibility-standards","api-versioning"]. After changing Sort to "Last Updated" and filtering by module "API", both favorited items still showed "Remove from favorites".
Knowledge Graph tab shows an interactive force-directed graph with nodes (circles+labels) for every document and connecting lines (edges) for relationships, with zoom/pan and node-click navigation.

Inspected /src/data/documents.ts programmatically: none of the 19 documents' relatedDocs arrays contain their own id (selfRefs: []). UI example: API Versioning Strategy's Related Documents list contains only REST API Design Guidelines and Error Handling Standards, not itself.

Graph SVG contains exactly 19 g.graph-node elements labeled with the 19 real document titles, colored per their module; handleNodeClick calls getDocumentById(nodeId) and shows an error toast if the id doesn't correspond to a real document, ensuring graph nodes correspond to actual documents/modules.

Source shows handleNodeClick: if getDocumentById(nodeId) returns null, it calls showToast('Document not found','error') and returns without crashing. Triggered this exact store action live in the running app and confirmed a toast "Document not found" rendered on screen with the app remaining fully functional afterward.

Chevron icon on each section header carries class "rotate-180" when expanded (REST Principles) and lacks it when collapsed (Endpoint Naming Conventions, Pagination & Filtering), giving a clear visual collapse/expand indicator.

Dispatching a click on the "REST API Design Guidelines" graph node set the selected document; switching to the Documents tab showed that same document open with its first section auto-expanded, confirming node click navigates to that document's view.
